STORE_BLR_002.layout_usage: The layout PNGs were used as visual references to understand store structure, customer-facing FOH area, entrance position, billing/cash counter location, and product display zones.
STORE_BLR_002.runtime_note: The detection pipeline does not run inference directly on the layout PNGs. YOLO runs on CCTV video frames. Zone detection uses CCTV frame coordinates configured in camera_zones.json.

mapped_zones.ENTRY_ZONE: Entrance and entry-facing customer movement region
mapped_zones.MAIN_FLOOR: FOH customer browsing and product display area
mapped_zones.BILLING: Cash counter and billing queue area

CAM_ENTRY_01.layout_interpretation: Entrance-facing camera used for entry, exit, and entry-zone movement

CAM_ZONE_01.layout_interpretation: FOH/main-floor camera covering browsing and partial billing overlap

CAM_ZONE_02.layout_interpretation: Second FOH/main-floor camera covering product display movement and dwell

CAM_BILLING_01.layout_interpretation: Billing camera focused on cash counter and billing queue region
